data.description:
## Goal

Determine how often the llama-proxy flips between **fast** and **cheap** modes,
what triggers each flip (in particular the ContextHub/herdr code that initiates
the switch to fast), whether the flip rate is problematic, and what (if
anything) should change to reduce it.

## Context / findings so far

Investigation of the 24h window 2026-10-14 14:02 → 2026-10-15 14:02 UTC found
**30 proxy restarts**, of which **15 were "Mode-switch restart spawned"**
(one restart per real mode transition).

Trigger sources identified:

- **ContextHub / herdr** — `../ContextHub/packages/herdr/src/mode-switch-worker.ts`:
  - *Fast on command*: records operator activity and fire-and-forget
    `POST /admin/set-mode {"mode":"fast"}`.
  - *Cheap on idle*: leader-only, when idle ≥
    `DEFAULT_MODE_SWITCH_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MS` (900_000 ms = 15 min) **and** the
    proxy reports idle, gated by the model-cooldown signal.
  - Shared activity broadcast via `mode-activity.json`; leader elected via the
    downtime worker; fail-closed everywhere.
- **Proxy's built-in time schedule** — `proxy/mode_schedule.yaml`
  (cheap 01:00, fast 10:00) = 2/day.
- **Manual** `POST /admin/set-mode` (operators/agents).

Each real transition persists the mode and spawns
`proxy/scripts/start-proxy.sh --restart` (`proxy/proxy/mode.py` `set_mode()` →
`_spawn_restart()`), because fast/cheap are separate config profiles
(`config-fast.yaml` vs `config-cheap.yaml`) with different slot-pool sizes
(fast: base `session_slot_pool_size: 1`; cheap: 3). The restart re-inits
llama-server and typically yields a ~60s local-qwen3 cooldown on a cold-start
503. Redundant switches are skipped (mode already matches), so transition count
== restart-contribution count.

**Is this period unusual?** Historical per-calendar-day mode-switch counts from
the rotated logs: 10-08=28, 10-09=22, 10-10=16, 10-11=10, 10-12=32, 10-13=24,
10-14=31, 10-15=19 (partial, ~14h). So flipping is **endemic (~10–34/day)** —
to be confirmed and extended in this investigation.

## Questions to answer

1. How many flips/day, split by trigger source (ContextHub fast-on-command,
   ContextHub idle-cheap, proxy schedule, manual)?
2. Is the fast-on-command path firing repeatedly during active periods
   (flip-flop)? Quantify fast→cheap→fast pairs within short windows.
3. What is the cost per flip (restart duration, local cooldown, dropped or
   retried in-flight work, cold-prefill thunder)?
4. What else (besides mode) causes the proxy to restart, and how much of the
   flip rate is attributable to each?
5. What options exist to reduce flipping (e.g. minimum-dwell/hysteresis, keep
   fast during working hours rather than idle-cheap, only switch when the
   benefit is real, coalesce/defer switches, non-destructive switch), with
   trade-offs?
6. Recommendation: act or not, and if so, what and with what measurable target?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Flip frequency over ≥7 days of logs is documented (per-day counts +
      intra-day distribution), separated by trigger source.
- [ ] The ContextHub `mode-switch-worker.ts` switching logic is documented
      (triggers, gates, thresholds, leader election, cooldown gate, fail-closed
      behaviour).
- [ ] A quantified answer to "was the studied 24h period unusual?" against the
      ≥7-day baseline.
- [ ] A cost-per-flip estimate (restart duration, local cooldown, in-flight
      impact, cold-prefill effect).
- [ ] A prioritised list of reduction options with expected effect and
      trade-offs, and at least one recommended option with a measurable target.
- [ ] Follow-up implementation work items are created for the recommended
      option(s), or a decision not to act is recorded.
- [ ] Evidence is command/log based and reproducible (exact greps/scripts
      recorded in this item).

## References

- Related items: LP-0MSM5K4TX004MICX (time-based schedule),
  LP-0MSMF5LXO006YDNM (in-flight sessions across mode switches),
  LP-0MSMFQ3DL006EY2H (grandfathered routing tests).
- Code: `proxy/proxy/mode.py`, `proxy/mode_schedule.yaml`,
  `../ContextHub/packages/herdr/src/mode-switch-worker.ts`.
- Logs: `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log*`.
data.title: Investigate fast<->cheap proxy mode-flip frequency and how to reduce it (ContextHub trigger focus)
